name: performance-release-gating
intent: Bind release readiness to measured performance evidence without confusing a local load fixture with production capacity.
successCondition: Stop when the bounded run set yields a reproducible pass or a failure receipt under the declared budgets.
outputs: baseline candidate variance and failure receipt
operations: freeze workload environment and warmup policy
run the candidate under identical bounded conditions
gate on predeclared latency throughput error and resource budgets
preconditions: the load target is local and authorized
budgets and run count are predeclared
positiveTriggers: Create a local performance release gate for a bounded workload.
Compare a candidate against a baseline budget with variance controls.
negativeTriggers: Generate load against an external or production target.
Deploy because one benchmark happened to pass.
failureModes: stop when the target or load authorization is unclear
fail the gate when variance or functional errors invalidate comparison
exclusions: does not claim production capacity from a local fixture
terminationConditions: Stop when the bounded run set yields a reproducible pass or a failure receipt under the declared budgets.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-herald route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
